<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL examples with query parameters, expecting continuation of the second URL example.

The question concerns URL query parameter ordering, specifically about a "flag" parameter appearing in different positions relative to other parameters like "foo=bar&flag=true".

The final token `?flag` is the start of a second URL example (`https://example.com/?flag`), which is incomplete and expects continuation — likely `=true` or additional parameters, or a contrasting scenario showing the flag alone or in a different position.
"First URL: `https://example.com/?foo=bar&flag=true&other=1`
Second URL: `https://example.com/?flag`" — the pattern suggests a parallel structure with a different parameter arrangement, likely `=true` or a new parameter name completing the query string.
</explanation>
